```{r}
#install.packages("readxl")  
library(readxl)
library(ggpubr)
```

```{r}
df <- read_excel("CLEANING DATA DRUG.xlsx", sheet = "DATA_FINAL_ANALYSIS")
head(df)
```
```{r}
legal_drugs <- c("Caffeine_Use", "Nicotine_Use", "Alcohol_Use", "Chocolate_Use")
illegal_drugs <- c("Cocaine_Use", "Ketamine_Use", "Heroin_Use", "LSD_Use")

# Gather legal and illegal drugs together with a flag
df_long <- df %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(c(legal_drugs, illegal_drugs)),
               names_to = "Drug",
               values_to = "Usage") %>%
  mutate(Category = ifelse(Drug %in% legal_drugs, "Legal", "Illegal"))
```

```{r}
# Plot personality trait by ussage and separate by Legal/Illegal category
neuro_boxplot <- ggplot(df_long, aes(x = Usage, y = Neuroticism, fill = Usage)) +
                  geom_boxplot() +
                  facet_wrap(~Category) +
                  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#BCB8F0", "#E9006D")) +
                  labs(x = "",
                       y = "Neuroticism Score",
                       fill = "Usage") +
                  guides(fill = "none") +
                  theme_classic() +
                  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

extraversion_boxplot <- ggplot(df_long, aes(x = Usage, y = Extraversion, fill = Usage)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  facet_wrap(~Category) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#BCB8F0", "#E9006D")) +
  labs(x = "",
       y = "Extraversion Score",
       fill = "Usage") +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

Openness_boxplot <- ggplot(df_long, aes(x = Usage, y = Openness, fill = Usage)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  facet_wrap(~Category) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#BCB8F0", "#E9006D")) +
  labs(x = "",
       y = "Openness Score",
       fill = "Usage") +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

Agreeableness_boxplot <- ggplot(df_long, aes(x = Usage, y = Agreeableness, fill = Usage)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  facet_wrap(~Category) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#BCB8F0", "#E9006D")) +
  labs(x = "",
       y = "Agreeableness Score",
       fill = "Usage") +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

combined_plot <- ggarrange(neuro_boxplot, extraversion_boxplot, Openness_boxplot, Agreeableness_boxplot,
          ncol = 2, nrow = 2)

# Add one common title above all plots
annotate_figure(combined_plot,
                top = text_grob("Personality Traits by Drug Use for Legal and Illegal Drugs", 
                                face = "bold", size = 14)) 
```

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(pheatmap)

#data
ddata <- read_excel(
  "CLEANING DATA DRUG.xlsx",
  sheet = "DATA_FINAL_ANALYSIS"
)

# age + ed
ddata$AgeEdu <- paste(ddata$Age_Group, ddata$Education_Level_Final, sep = " / ")

# drugs
keep_drugs <- c(
  "Caffeine_Use",
  "Nicotine_Use",
  "Alcohol_Use",
  "Chocolate_Use",
  "Cocaine_Use",
  "Ketamine_Use",
  "Heroin_Use",
  "LSD_Use"
)

d_long <- ddata %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(keep_drugs),
    names_to  = "Drug",
    values_to = "Use"
  ) %>%
  filter(Use == "User")

#clean labels 
pretty_drug_labels <- function(mat) {
  labs <- colnames(mat)
  labs <- gsub("_Use$", "", labs)
  labs <- gsub("_", " ", labs)
  labs
}

# color
overall_colors <- colorRampPalette(c("white", "#b38bff"))(50)   
male_colors    <- colorRampPalette(c("white", "#6bb6ff"))(50)  
female_colors  <- colorRampPalette(c("white", "#ff8ac6"))(50)   


# overall heatmap
all_tab <- d_long %>%
  count(AgeEdu, Drug, name = "Users") %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = Drug,
    values_from = Users,
    values_fill = 0
  )

mat_all <- as.matrix(all_tab[, -1])
rownames(mat_all) <- all_tab$AgeEdu

pheatmap(
  mat_all,
  main = "Drug Use by Age + Education (All)",
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  labels_col = pretty_drug_labels(mat_all),
  color = overall_colors
)

#male heatmap 
male_tab <- d_long %>%
  filter(Gender == "Male") %>%
  count(AgeEdu, Drug, name = "Users") %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = Drug,
    values_from = Users,
    values_fill = 0
  )

mat_male <- as.matrix(male_tab[, -1])
rownames(mat_male) <- male_tab$AgeEdu

pheatmap(
  mat_male,
  main = "Drug Use by Age + Education (Male)",
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  labels_col = pretty_drug_labels(mat_male),
  color = male_colors
)

# female heatmap
female_tab <- d_long %>%
  filter(Gender == "Female") %>%
  count(AgeEdu, Drug, name = "Users") %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = Drug,
    values_from = Users,
    values_fill = 0
  )

mat_female <- as.matrix(female_tab[, -1])
rownames(mat_female) <- female_tab$AgeEdu

pheatmap(
  mat_female,
  main = "Drug Use by Age + Education (Female)",
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  labels_col = pretty_drug_labels(mat_female),
  color = female_colors
)

```
